description: Looks up and validates an ISTAT ATECO activity code (2007/2022 or 2025) and returns its description and hierarchy, with the official correspondence between the two editions: for an ATECO 2007/2022 code, the corresponding ATECO 2025 codes in `ateco_2025` (`copertura` TOTALE or PARZIALE = full or partial coverage, `ambiguo` if there is more than one); for an ATECO 2025 code, the corresponding 2007/2022 code, to which the forfettario coefficients are tied. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

ateco.description: Alias di `code` (codice ATECO): stesso dato, accettato perché altri tool di questo server lo chiamano così. Se mandi entrambi i nomi, i valori devono coincidere.

code.description: The ATECO 2007/2022 or 2025 code (digits and dots only, e.g. 62.01).
